title: nephrodium effusum var. excultum

The health benefits of Excultum fern include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Excultum fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
